meta.description: Portfolio of Nayeon Cho, a former production process operator at Linde Korea with a software development background, aiming for a technical sales career.

hero.role: Former production process operator with a software development background, looking to build a career in technical sales.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I worked for about five years as a process operator on the production team at Linde Korea, then graduated from the Computer Programming diploma program at Conestoga College in June 2026.
I'm especially interested in technical sales — roles where I can combine hands-on production experience with software skills to understand technical problems and explain solutions clearly.

Through my coursework and personal projects I learned Python, web and mobile development, databases, and software testing. I use these skills to understand how technical products work and to explain them in plain language.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.intro: Four things I can bring to a technical sales team.

items.title: Hands-on production experience
items.description: About five years as a production-team process operator at Linde Korea, plus certifications in electricity, production automation, and electronic CAD. I'm familiar with how a production site runs and the equipment used there.

items.title: Explaining technical topics clearly
items.description: I turn what I study into plain-language notes and visual tools: six written learning notes, and a sorting-algorithm visualizer that shows comparisons and swaps live.

items.title: Software skills that support customers
items.description: Python, SQL, and app development help me understand how software products work and build simple tools or demos when they are needed.

items.title: Teamwork and ownership
items.description: I finished three projects, two of them in teams. I made 18 of 23 commits on a three-person mobile app and 55 of 88 on a two-person web service.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Three projects from my diploma program, each showing a different strength.

booking.title: Meeting Room Booking App
booking.description: A cross-platform mobile app for finding and booking meeting rooms, built with a team of three using Flutter and Dart.
highlights: 7 screens: home, bookings, room detail, new booking, map, camera, settings
Local SQLite database with 4 tables: room categories, rooms, bookings, reviews
GPS location with a nearest-room calculation and a map view

sorting.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
sorting.description: An interactive program that shows how Bubble, Merge, and Quick Sort work step by step, so the difference between them is easy to see. Built on my own with Python and Pygame.
highlights: 3 algorithms with color-coded comparisons and sorted items
Live counters for comparisons and swaps
Controls to reset the array, change speed, and switch algorithms

forum.title: Forum Web App
forum.description: A Reddit-style forum service with user accounts, three permission levels, and an admin statistics view, built with a team of two using Node.js and TypeScript.
highlights: 3 roles: user, admin, super admin, with JWT login and bcrypt password hashing
10 Jest unit tests, run without a database

blog.title: Learning Notes
blog.intro: Technical topics I studied, written up in my own words as practice in explaining what I learn.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: I'm currently open to new opportunities, especially technical sales roles. Whether it's a job, a project, or just a chat — feel free to reach out.
